text:
Jordan K.: Hi @people-ops I need help. My manager gave repeated public feedback about missed deadlines last week and asked me to present a postmortem live in the all-hands. That situation triggers my anxiety and Id prefer an alternative format. Can People Ops help with a reasonable accommodation to present asynchronously or have a neutral moderator? I'd also like confidential mediation to prevent future public callouts.

Sam (People Ops): Hi Jordan  we can help. Two paths: 1) document a reasonable accommodation to adjust the format (pre-recorded + Q&A doc) and short-term workload tweaks, or 2) mediation between you and your manager to align expectations. Accommodations are confidential and won't be used against you. Which would you like to try first? :lock:

Jordan K.: Accommodation first please. Specifically: allow a pre-recorded 10min walkthrough, host live Q&A via a shared doc (no live presentation), and ask that public critique be avoided in meetings. I'm worried about being singled out.

Evan (Eng Manager): Jordan, Im sorry you felt singled outthat wasnt my intent. Im fine with the pre-record and moderated Q&A. If People Ops thinks mediation would help, Im open to that too.

Sam (People Ops): Filing intake: https://intra.redwood/hr/ada-request. Case ID: HR-2026-523. Accommodation logged: presentation format adjustment (pre-record + doc Q&A), optional temporary workload reprioritization, and offer of mediation. Visibility limited to People Ops and Evan unless you request broader sharing.

Jordan K.: Thanks, Sam. Ill submit a short provider note for the intake and would like the all-hands presentation deferred one week while we set this up. Confidentiality appreciated.

hrbot: [Automated] Accommodation intake submitted for Jordan K. Case HR-2026-523. People Ops will follow up within 2 business days.

Sam (People Ops): Got it  we'll follow up to schedule the moderator and confirm the deferral. If you want an interim rehearsal or talking points reviewed, we can arrange that.

Evan (Eng Manager): Presentation deferred one week. Jordan, happy to give you rehearsal time or a dry run with the moderator.

Jordan K.: Thank you all, really appreciate the support. :heart:
